criteria.given: alice signed in, with a list containing at least three books (added via "Search books" / "Add") whose titles and first authors differ and were added in an order that is neither alphabetical by title nor by author
criteria.then: the "Books" section shows a select labelled "Sort by" with options "Date added", "Title", "Author" ("Date added" selected) and a button "Sort", and the books are listed in the order they were added (oldest first)

criteria.given: the list of AC1 open on /lists/{id}
criteria.then: the URL is /lists/{id}?sort=title, "Title" is selected, and the books are listed in ascending case-insensitive order of their titles; after a reload the same order and selection are shown
criteria.when: alice selects "Title" in "Sort by" and presses "Sort"

criteria.given: the list of AC1 open on /lists/{id}
criteria.then: the URL is /lists/{id}?sort=author, "Author" is selected, and the books are listed in ascending case-insensitive order of their first displayed author name, books shown as "Unknown author" last and equal authors ordered by title; after a reload the same order and selection are shown
criteria.when: alice selects "Author" in "Sort by" and presses "Sort"

criteria.then: each shows the books in date-added order (oldest first) with "Date added" selected, and no error message or error status is shown
criteria.when: alice selects "Date added" and presses "Sort"; separately, opens /lists/{id} without a sort parameter and /lists/{id}?sort=bogus

criteria.given: alice has sorted her list by "Title" and by "Author" (AC2, AC3) and has a share link for it created with "Create share link"
criteria.then: the owner page shows date-added order with "Date added" selected (the choice was not saved), and the share page shows the books in date-added order with no "Sort by" control; the list's books are unchanged (same books, no duplicates, none removed)
criteria.when: she opens /lists/{id} without a sort parameter (also after signing out and in again), and an anonymous visitor opens the share link, also with ?sort=title appended

criteria.given: alice signed in with a list that has no books
criteria.then: both show "This list has no books yet." without an error, and the rest of the page (Edit, Delete list, Search books, Create share link) works as before

criteria.conditions: alice signed in; GET /lists/{id}?sort=title for a list with at least three books, at 375, 768 and 1280 px width
criteria.metric: axe-core violations with impact serious or critical (WCAG 2.1 A/AA rule tags)

criteria.then: the new book appears in the "Books" section at its title-sorted position (after the page updates or a reload of the same URL)
criteria.when: she searches for a book and presses "Add" on a result

criteria.statement: The "Sort by" control fits the existing look of the list page, sits with the "Books" heading, is usable by keyboard, and does not cause horizontal overflow at phone, tablet and desktop widths.

interface.ui: On /lists/{id} (owner only), inside the section with heading "Books", when the list has at least one book: a select labelled "Sort by" with exactly the options "Date added" (default), "Title", "Author", and a button "Sort" that applies the selection by navigating to /lists/{id}?sort=added, /lists/{id}?sort=title or /lists/{id}?sort=author respectively (an implementation may also apply the selection immediately on change, but the "Sort" button must work). GET /lists/{id}?sort=title and ?sort=author render the books in that order with the matching option pre-selected in "Sort by"; no sort parameter, sort=added, or any other/unknown value renders date-added order (oldest first, as before) with "Date added" selected and no error. Order rules: "Title" = ascending by title, case-insensitive; "Author" = ascending by the first listed author name as displayed (e.g. "Frank Herbert"), case-insensitive, with books shown as "Unknown author" last; ties are broken by title (case-insensitive), then by date added. Each book item keeps its existing content (title, author(s), first publish year). The share page /s/{token} is unchanged: no "Sort by" control, books in date-added order, and a sort query parameter on it is ignored. Reused names: seeded user alice@example.test / Correct-Horse-1 (T2), "Search books" / "Search" / "Add" (T3), "Link expires in" / "Create share link" / "Share link" (T4).

non_goals: saving the sort order on the list or per user (no schema change)
sorting or a sort control on the share page /s/{token} (it keeps date-added order)
sorting on the lists index /lists or in book search results
descending order (Z-A) or sorting by other fields (e.g. first publish year)
surname-aware or locale-specific collation rules beyond case-insensitive comparison
manual reordering (drag and drop) of books

scope.summary: On the owner's list page /lists/{id}, the owner can view the list's books sorted by title or by author instead of the default order (date added). The sort is a view-only choice (owner decision): it is carried in the page URL (query parameter sort) so it survives a reload and can be bookmarked, but it is not saved on the list, does not change the stored books, and does not affect the read-only share page /s/{token}, which keeps showing books in the order they were added. Existing behaviour of the list page (T2-T4, T6) and its access rules are unchanged.

title: Sort books by title or author
